title: Applicationevent accesses Objectschema
description: The application event carries values of the declared shape as its payload, so the event cannot be emitted or interpreted without that schema. Use accesses to an application data object instead when the payload has no declared shape, or is a class with logic of its own over its state.
x-dr-evidence: The event class declares a field typed by the interface, record or entity, or the event topic's Avro or JSON schema references the object schema's definition.
